'''Greg Tuck''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 56 from Flower Mound, Tx. The fan site's Squadron Members table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He played from early 1996.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
One of the oldest SMs, I remember taking my girlfriend to a drive-in to watch the original Star Wars.

I've been playing SWCCG since early 1996 and so I've seen all the trends, expansions, ups, and downs and you know what?

I LOVE THIS GAME!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
